title: Delicious Acai Smoothie
description: A refreshing and healthy acai smoothie made with juicy acai berries and your favorite fruits.

ingredients.name: Juicy Acai Berries
ingredients.notes: Frozen acai berries work well too.

instructions: Add acai berries, banana, and almond milk to a blender.
Add honey if you want a sweeter smoothie.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
You can also add other fruits like berries or mango for extra flavor.
Experiment with different combinations to find your favorite.
